target.robustness_reasoning: The admin login control is targeted by its data-testid attribute 'btn-quick-login-admin', which is an explicit test hook baked into the app's markup rather than a styling class or DOM position. data-testid values are the app's contract for automation and survive CSS refactors, copy changes, and re-layout of the auth card, so this locator will resolve on every future replay. Visible text 'Login as Admin' is supplied only as a fallback. This is the app's built-in admin credential path, so it needs no hardcoded username/password that could rotate between runs.

steps.idempotency_note: Safe to re-click while still on /login -- it re-authenticates the same admin session rather than creating anything. Once login has succeeded the app navigates away and this button no longer exists, so a replay that retries should re-check the URL rather than blindly re-clicking.
